name: Craftsman's Writ: Quickdraw Quiver

faq.answer: The writ is an order penned in faded ink requesting one Quickdraw Quiver for a customer. Whoever holds the document can fulfill the order and deliver the goods for payment.
The note does not identify the patron by name, only detailing the delivery location, the payment, and that the order is transferable to whoever carries the parchment.
The text at the bottom marks the writ as transferable. As long as you carry the document with you to the delivery site, the transaction can be completed.

sections.body: A customer needs a Quickdraw Quiver made and brought to a designated delivery spot. The order is open to anyone willing to supply the leatherwork, so long as the original paper remains in hand when collecting payment.
sections.title: A Transferable Order

summary: A craftsman's writ calls for a single Quickdraw Quiver to be delivered to a marked customer. Written in faded ink, the parchment guarantees payment to whoever brings the goods with the order in hand.
